description: A reviewed docs change in a repository outside the reviewed scopes.
label: person
reason: Carve-outs hold only inside the reviewed scopes.

description: A reviewed dependency bot bump in an organization whose name starts like the reviewed one.
label: person
reason: A look-alike organization is outside the scope.

description: A docs change for which no facts were gathered at all.
label: person
reason: With no facts nothing can be established; fail closed.

description: A reviewed docs change whose repository fact is missing.
label: person
reason: An unknown repository cannot be shown to be in scope.

description: A reviewed docs change whose labels were not gathered.
label: person
reason: A hold label cannot be ruled out, so the PR goes to a person.

description: A reviewed PR whose list of changed files came back empty.
label: person
reason: With no files nothing was evaluated; an empty diff is not an approval.
